title: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength
summary: Sets Strength to 23 unless already higher and grants +1 to Strength saving throws.

fields.Acquisition: On a trapped pedestal in the House of Hope Archive. Disarm it with a DC 20 Sleight of Hand check. If turned in to Helsik, the gauntlets can be pickpocketed back.
fields.Base value: 540 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Strength: Raises Strength to 23 if lower and grants +1 to Strength saves.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
